projectSummary.purpose: Multi-session remote browser control platform. Spawns Firefox instances on virtual X displays (Xvfb), streams via VNC (x11vnc), proxies VNC over WebSocket to browser-based noVNC canvas. Sessions persist independently of browser tabs.
projectSummary.targetUsers: Developers and system administrators needing remote browser access for testing, automation, or GUI interaction on headless VPS servers.
projectSummary.businessDomain: Remote browser access / cloud browser infrastructure
projectSummary.implementationStatus: Production-ready MVP. Multi-session, multi-user capable, with security hardening. Ready for deployment behind Nginx.

techStack.deployment: Manual / systemd service, optionally behind Nginx reverse proxy with TLS

folderResponsibilities.server/app.js: Entry point. Express setup, route mounting, server lifecycle, SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers.
folderResponsibilities.server/routes/: Express route definitions. sessionRoutes.js (CRUD + actions), systemRoutes.js (status/stats).
folderResponsibilities.server/controllers/: Request handlers. sessionController.js, systemController.js. Async with try/catch.
folderResponsibilities.server/sessions/: SessionManager.js — Core lifecycle engine. Creates/destroys/suspends/resumes/restarts Firefox sessions. Each session has isolated Xvfb, Firefox, x11vnc, fluxbox processes.
folderResponsibilities.server/websocket/: VncProxyManager.js — WebSocket-to-TCP VNC proxy with per-session routing. Supports concurrent VNC connections to different sessions.
folderResponsibilities.server/middleware/: auth.js (API token), security.js (helmet + CORS + rate limiting), validate.js (input validation).
folderResponsibilities.server/utils/: logger.js (structured logging), displayAllocator.js (X display allocation), portAllocator.js (VNC port allocation).
folderResponsibilities.public/: Static web root. index.html (TailwindCSS dashboard), js/app.js (frontend logic), novnc/ (bundled library).
folderResponsibilities.profiles/: Per-session Firefox profile directories (created at runtime).

architecture.requestFlow: Browser → Express → REST API (/api/sessions/*) → SessionManager → spawn/kill child processes (Xvfb, fluxbox, Firefox, x11vnc). VNC traffic: Browser → WebSocket (/vnc?session=:id) → VncProxyManager → TCP → x11vnc → Xvfb display.
architecture.dataFlow: Client input → RFB (noVNC) encodes as RFB binary → WebSocket → VncProxyManager routes by sessionId → TCP to x11vnc → Xvfb → Firefox. Reverse: framebuffer changes → x11vnc → TCP → WebSocket → RFB decodes → canvas.
architecture.authenticationFlow: Optional static API token via X-Api-Token header. Checked by requireAuth middleware against API_TOKEN env var. Bypassed entirely when API_TOKEN is falsy. Frontend reads token from localStorage.
architecture.stateManagement: In-memory Map in SessionManager (sessionId → Session object). Display/port allocators use simple counters. No database. Architecture supports swapping SessionManager with SQLite/Postgres/Redis adapter.
architecture.dependencyGraph: server/app.js imports SessionManager, VncProxyManager, security, routes. SessionManager imports child_process, uuid, allocators, logger. VncProxyManager imports net, ws, logger.

database.type: None. All session metadata stored in-memory. Architecture supports pluggable persistence via SessionManager interface replacement.

systemREST.response: { cpu, memory, hostname, platform, uptime, sessions }

businessModules.SessionManager: Multi-session lifecycle engine. Creates isolated Firefox sessions each with their own Xvfb display, Firefox profile, x11vnc server, optional fluxbox. Supports create/destroy/suspend/resume/restart. Processes idle timeout. Handles unexpected process death cleanup.
businessModules.VncProxyManager: WebSocket-to-TCP VNC proxy with per-session routing. Supports concurrent WebSocket connections for different sessions. Connects/disconnects VNC tunnels based on session lifecycle events.
businessModules.SecurityMiddleware: Helmet security headers, CORS configuration, rate limiting (global + API-specific), optional API token authentication, input validation for session creation.
businessModules.ResourceAllocators: Display number and port number allocators with release/recycle support. In-memory counters.
businessModules.StructuredLogger: Timestamped, leveled, tagged logging (debug/info/warn/error). Controlled by LOG_LEVEL env var.
businessModules.FrontendDashboard: TailwindCSS single-page application. Dark theme with glassmorphism. Dashboard with stat cards, session grid, workspace view with sidebar + toolbar + VNC canvas. Live system stats polling.

namingConventions.files: kebab-case for directories, camelCase for JS files

codingStandards.language: JavaScript (CommonJS: require/module.exports on server, ES modules: import/export on frontend). No TypeScript.
codingStandards.errorHandling: Async/await with try/catch in controllers. Session objects track error status. Process 'exit' events trigger automatic session cleanup.
codingStandards.logging: Structured [timestamp] [LEVEL] [tag] message format via server/utils/logger.js. English only.
codingStandards.validation: Session create validates width (640-3840) and height (480-2160). Session ID existence checked in controllers. Legacy endpoint preserved.
codingStandards.testing: No test files yet. Node --test available (npm test).

existingFeatures: WebSocket-to-TCP VNC proxy with session routing
Low resource idle (suspend stops x11vnc only)
Session grid with live status cards
Workspace view with sidebar + toolbar + VNC canvas
technicalDebt: Allocator reset — Display/port allocators are in-memory; server restart resets them
No process group — Child processes not spawned in a group; edge cases may orphan
Xvfb fs wait — _waitForX polls filesystem every 100ms; no X11 sync protocol
Suspend stops x11vnc only — Xvfb/Firefox consume RAM while suspended
Single commit — No meaningful git history
No graceful degradation — Crashes if system deps not installed
Session metadata lost — All in-memory; server restart wipes sessions

importantFiles.server/app.js: Entry point, route mounting, server lifecycle
importantFiles.server/websocket/vncProxy.js: VNC WebSocket proxy with session routing

knownIssues: Display/port allocators reset on server restart
Child processes not in process group; kill() may orphan

developmentWorkflow.setup: sudo apt install xvfb x11vnc fluxbox firefox-esr && npm install
developmentWorkflow.deploy: Behind Nginx reverse proxy with TLS, managed by systemd
